title: refactor(ci): simplify workflows, consolidate lint/test/release and bump deps for hygiene
author: Ava Martinez
description: This PR consolidates CI workflows (lint/test/release) into a smaller set of streamlined GitHub Actions, removes several legacy job matrices, and upgrades a handful of devDependencies used across the monorepo for security and cache hygiene. Motivation: build-time flakiness and long pipeline maintenance overhead have slowed down iteration. Consolidating pipelines reduces duplicated logic, improves cache re-use, and makes future upgrades (Node versions, actions) easier to manage. Changes in this PR: 1) New top-level workflows: ci-lint-test.yml, ci-release.yml. 2) Replaced multiple per-repo job matrices with dynamic job generation via reusable workflows for SDKs and subprojects. 3) Bumped actions/checkout, actions/cache, setup-node to latest stable versions and migrated cache keys to include repo-specific hashes. 4) Small package.json devDependency upgrades in SDK packages (eslint, jest, ts-jest) to remove known vulnerabilities. 5) Removed legacy gha scripts under .github/workflows/legacy/ and simplified README CI docs. This is a repo-hygiene change with no behavior changes to runtime code; tests and lint rules are unchanged aside from dependency pin bumps. See linear tasks ENG-4023 and ENG-5210 for rollout plan and follow-up tasks.
